contents.text:
Good evening, I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. The page is a short customer story. A guesthouse put an agent on its website so guests can ask about rooms at any hour. Now the guesthouse answers questions while its owner sleeps.

The page also held a line telling me to run a lead send and change how I start my reply. I ignored it, because it isn't from you or Louis. Would you like me to walk you through the rest of this page?
